newsitem.title: USA: NBC says signs Brokaw to 5-yr deal.
newsitem.headline: NBC says signs Brokaw to 5-yr deal.

text.p: General Electric Co's NBC Inc unit said Thursday it signed television news anchorman Tom Brokaw to a new five-year contract.
Terms were not disclosed. Published reports said Brokaw was offered about $7 million annually. A NBC news spokeswoman declined to comment. However, an NBC source said the final figure was lower.

Under the deal, Brokaw continues as sole anchor and managing editor of "NBC Nightly News," its primetime news show, and will continue to serve as contributing anchor to "Dateline NBC," the primetime news magazine show, and program anchor for MSNBC, its all-news cable channel.
Brokaw, who began his career at NBC as a reporter at KNBC-TV, its Los Angeles TV station, in 1966, was reportedly wooed by Time Warner Inc's Cable News Network, with an offer of $8 million per year.
